statements.status_notes: Upstream fixed CVE-2025-59375 (disproportionate dynamic memory allocations from a small document) in Expat 2.7.2 (libexpat issue #1018, PR #1034; https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/blob/R_2_7_2/expat/Changes). Debian fixed it for trixie in 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6404-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-59375). Checked the libexpat1 library in every expat build published in the DHI Debian repository, on amd64 and arm64: the builds of upstream 2.7.1 report expat_2.7.1 and lack the allocation tracker the fix adds (XML_SetAllocTrackerActivationThreshold), while every build from 2.8.2-1~deb13u1 on reports expat_2.8.2, expat_2.8.3 or expat_2.9.0 and exports that function. The range's fixed version is the lowest of those fixed builds; the 2.7.1 builds sort below it and stay on the affected side of the range.
